from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from mashumaro import DataClassDictMixin, field_options
from mashumaro.config import BaseConfig
@dataclass
class Child(DataClassDictMixin):
    x: int = field(metadata=field_options(alias='xx'))
    class Config(BaseConfig): forbid_extra_keys = True; serialize_by_alias = True
@dataclass
class Parent(DataClassDictMixin):
    c: Child = field(metadata=field_options(flatten=True, flatten_rename={'x':'renamed'}))
p = Parent(Child(1))
print(p.to_dict())
print(Parent.from_dict(p.to_dict()))
